query:
SELECT t.machine_id as "machine_id!", t.cpu_pct,
               (100.0 * t.mem_used / NULLIF(t.mem_total, 0))::float8 AS "mem_pct?"
        FROM machines m
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT machine_id, ts, cpu_pct, mem_used, mem_total
            FROM metrics
            WHERE machine_id = m.id
            ORDER BY ts DESC
            LIMIT $1
        ) t
        ORDER BY t.machine_id, t.ts ASC
